title: White Rose 2016
text: Several SuffOC members attended this year's White Rose weekend in Dalby Forest on the N York Moors and two of our Junior women - Chloë & Bronwen - were rewarded with podium places, and the coveted White Rose mugs, for their combined scores in the Middle and Classic distance races. The weather was unkind, the terrain physically challenging, but Chloë came second in the W16A class (and 7th overall on the Green course, against many highly experienced competitors) and Bronwen was 1st in the W18S. Well done, young ladies!!
